segments.line: You wake up, and the world has changed.
Above every head, a little green label.
written where only you can see it.
Everyone's biggest allergy, written where only you can see it.
On the bus, the big guy's label says PEANUTS.
The girl by the window: POLLEN.
Even the driver: CATS. The labels never lie.
They don't change. And nobody else can see them. Only you.
What if you could read anyone's allergies? Not just the big ones.
Not just the obvious ones. Every single one.
All day, every day. Labels above every head.
Stick around, because by the end of this, it won't feel like one.
